title: [dev] Occasional Crash/Restart occurs with no obvious cause
body:
I have been experiencing this problem at random intervals, a few days to a few weeks apart with various build versions over the past few months, since I started looping with the dev code.
- Dana-i pump
- Libre2 via patched app and xdrip+
- Samsung A20e running Android 11
- Currently on (new) Objective 9 trying out SMBs

I rebuilt Version: 2.8.2.5-dev BuildVersion: b4e7d4b72-2021.10.07-00:30 and the failure re-occured after 3 days.  I was asleep at the time, so there were no user operations.
In the 10Oct log file, the restart is at 06:21:03.022 
[AndroidAPS spontaneous restart at 10102021 0621.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7325161/AndroidAPS.spontaneous.restart.at.10102021.0621.log)

I have an earlier log using Version: 2.8.2.2-dev BuildVersion: 15e61108d-2021.07.13-21:07
In the 19Aug log file, the restart is at 13:08:08.924
[AndroidAPS spontaneous restart at 19082021 1308.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7325240/AndroidAPS.spontaneous.restart.at.19082021.1308.log)
I was on Objective 8 using the AMA algorithm.

I have been unable to identify any clues to the failures in the preceding log messages.

The recovery after the restart is successful, so I am only aware of the problem via the restart message displayed on the graph.
